title: [Main]- Export Electronic Payments: one vendor's missing email can clear another vendor's Document No.
summary: Fixed a bug in electronic payments export where a missing email address for one vendor could incorrectly clear the Document No. field for another vendor.
key_points: Fixes Export Electronic Payments so a missing email for one vendor no longer clears another vendor's Document No.
Change is in the NA Bulk Vendor Remit Reporting codeunit
Adds tests in ERM Electronic Funds Transfer
quote: Export Electronic Payments: one vendor's missing email can clear another vendor's Document No.
